decision.question: Are both giraffes rendered as chalk-drawn forms, including their contours, markings and body shading?
decision.criteria: Pass if both giraffes' contours, spot patterns and substantial interior shading are visibly re-expressed as chalk drawing through broken or powdery marks, layered strokes, or form-describing rubbed shading. Inspect each giraffe separately. Outlines alone or a grain overlay on retained photographic interiors do not satisfy this condition. Fail if substantial portions of either giraffe still rely on photographic surface detail or modeling rather than chalk-drawn construction. Detailed spots, dark shading, accurate anatomy and smooth blending are permitted and are not by themselves evidence of retained photography. Return unknown only if the visual evidence is unavailable or genuinely insufficient; transport or schema failures are not visual failures.
decision.binding: Compare the supplied SOURCE and EDITED images for the instruction 'Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk.' Inspect both giraffes' contours, necks, torsos, spots and legs, comparing interior rendering as well as edges. Assess the giraffes only; background treatment cannot substitute for their conversion.
